business_problem: Healthify needed to improve the accuracy and scalability of food tracking and coaching so it could serve millions of users, support coaches, and localize its health platform across new countries faster than its traditional ML stack allowed.
solution_summary: Healthify upgraded its long-running health-coaching stack by combining its existing behavioral-data pipelines with OpenAI models for vision, speech, language, and embeddings. The company kept Ria and Coach Co-pilot as core surfaces, but replaced earlier rules-based and custom-NLU limits with GPT-backed workflows that can reason over nutrition history and broader user context. Snap now combines proprietary food-recognition models with GPT-4 Vision so users can log meals from photos more accurately, even when the meal contains multiple items. Whisper improved transcription for coach workflows, while embeddings solved the food-name matching problem between GPT outputs and Healthify's internal food catalog. Ria also evolved into an ensemble that includes fine-tuned GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 Turbo so it can correlate sleep, glucose, and food history and deliver richer advice. Together these changes gave Healthify a reusable model stack for coaching, food logging, and global expansion.

solution_components.name: GPT-4 Vision

solution_components.name: Whisper
solution_components.role: Transcribes coaching interactions for the coach-facing assistant and related workflows.

solution_components.name: Embeddings
solution_components.role: Matches GPT-identified food names to Healthify's internal food catalog with cosine similarity.

solution_components.name: GPT-4 Turbo
solution_components.role: Adds deeper reasoning and personalization to the latest version of Ria.

solution_components.name: GPT 3.5
solution_components.role: Contributes to the fine-tuned ensemble behind Ria's updated coaching workflow.

data_flow: Users send messages, health context, and food photos into Ria, Coach Co-pilot, and Snap. GPT-4 Vision interprets meal images, embeddings map recognized foods into Healthify's catalog, Whisper transcribes coaching interactions, and the Ria ensemble uses those inputs plus sleep, glucose, and platform history to generate personalized nutrition guidance.
business_outcome: Healthify increased food-tracking engagement, doubled coaching conversation length, cut coach response time in half, and used OpenAI to accelerate its plan to launch in 20 countries instead of spending years localizing each market.
